headline_seed: Did Trump save eight Iranian women from execution?

what: Did Trump save eight Iranian women from execution?

clean_source_blocks.text: The US president says he saved eight Iranian women from execution, but Iran says otherwise.
Iran responded by saying that none of the women Trump mentioned were ever facing execution and accused the president of fake reports.
US President Donald Trump claimed that his intervention helped save eight women arrested in Iran from the death penalty.
Pro-government demonstrators poured onto the streets of the Iranian capital after the announcement of the two-week conditional ceasefire between the US and Iran.

source_text:
The US president says he saved eight Iranian women from execution, but Iran says otherwise.

Iran responded by saying that none of the women Trump mentioned were ever facing execution and accused the president of fake reports.

US President Donald Trump claimed that his intervention helped save eight women arrested in Iran from the death penalty.

Pro-government demonstrators poured onto the streets of the Iranian capital after the announcement of the two-week conditional ceasefire between the US and Iran.
